hero.title: TERRAVYN
hero.subtitle: AI-Powered Smart Agriculture & Intelligent Irrigation Platform
hero.desc: Transforming farming through IoT-driven monitoring, precision irrigation, and sustainable innovation.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities
features.subtitle: Everything you need to monitor and control your farm from anywhere.
features.f1_desc: Automate your watering schedules based on real-time soil moisture and hyper-local weather forecasting.
features.f2_desc: View up-to-the-second data streams from your ESP32 sensors straight into your dashboard via WebSockets.
features.f3_desc: Receive instant notifications for offline devices, pump failures, or critical moisture levels.

howItWorks.title: How TERRAVYN Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get started with TERRAVYN in just a few simple steps.
howItWorks.step1_desc: Choose the TERRAVYN smart irrigation device that suits your farming needs.
howItWorks.step2_desc: Power on the device and connect it to your farm's WiFi network using the simple setup process.
howItWorks.step3_desc: Register and log in to the TERRAVYN platform to access your personal dashboard.
howItWorks.step4_desc: Scan the QR code provided with your TERRAVYN device to securely link it to your account.
howItWorks.step5_desc: View soil moisture, weather conditions, and device status in real time.
howItWorks.step6_desc: Enable automatic irrigation or manually control your pump directly from the TERRAVYN dashboard.
howItWorks.videoDesc: Watch how farmers can set up TERRAVYN and begin smart farming within minutes.
